description.ja: 2024年12月公開。推論・数学特化モデル。14Bパラメータ。9.8兆トークン学習。GPT-4o生成の高品質合成データ使用。MMLU 84.8%、MATH 80.4%、HumanEval 82.6%達成。Gemini Pro 1.5を数学競技問題で上回り、GPT-4oを一部推論タスクで上回る。単一GPUまたはNPUラップトップで実行可能。
description.en: Released December 2024. Reasoning and math specialized. 14B parameters. 9.8T tokens training. Uses high-quality synthetic data from GPT-4o. Achieves 84.8% MMLU, 80.4% MATH, 82.6% HumanEval. Outperforms Gemini Pro 1.5 on math competitions, GPT-4o on some reasoning tasks. Runnable on single GPU or NPU laptop.

specs.architecture: Dense decoder-only Transformer, SFT + iterative DPO, Math reasoning specialized

description.ja: 14Bで5倍大きなモデルを数学・推論で上回る。2〜4倍高速推論。
description.en: 14B outperforms 5x larger models on math/reasoning. 2-4x faster inference.
